verdict.rationale: A server-side moderation and session-management API is a fair question for a real-time media relay, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only JWT authentication, publish/subscribe relaying and automatic broadcast discovery. There is no documented admin API to list sessions, mute or remove participants, or end a session, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop
